name: 16AN Push Lock Hose per foot
description:
ColorFittings 16AN Push-Lock Hose is a premium, race-proven fuel and oil hose designed for performance automotive, marine, and aviation applications. Sold by the foot, this push-lock AN hose is compatible with water, motor oil, E85, and race fuel — making it the go-to choice for builders who need a reliable, leak-free plumbing solution.

Push-lock hose is the fastest way to build an AN plumbing system — no assembly tools, no crimping, no hassle. Simply push the hose onto any of our Push-Loc Fittings for a secure, professional connection every time. Whether you're routing fuel lines on a drag car, building an oil cooler system, or plumbing a track day build, our push-lock hose delivers performance you can count on.

Specifications — 16AN Push-Lock Hose:

 	Max. Operating Pressure: 250 PSI
 	Temperature Range: -40°C to 100°C (-40°F to 212°F)
 	Compatible with: water, oil, E85, race fuel, coolant
 	Sold by the foot — order the exact length you need

Compatible With Our Full Push-Loc Lineup
This hose pairs directly with our full range of Push-Loc AN Fittings. Available in multiple anodized colors to match your build.

Finish the look with our lightweight Hose Separators, available in a variety of gloss-finish colors.

New to AN fittings? Check out our complete AN Fitting Guide to find the right hose and fittings for your application.
